subject: If B/C: benchmark with and without; record the per-category delta
description: Re-run the SRQ1 benchmark across all four categories with the flag off and on. Record the WMAPE delta per category and per model. Report whatever it is -- F1 and F2 both predict a small or null effect at monthly grain, which is a publishable finding rather than a failure. Check whether the holiday feature is merely re-encoding month/peak_month by comparing SHAP attributions between the two runs.
